fields.name: discount1
fields.description: Calculates 3% of the value in the 'Final Total (from Proposals)' field.
fields.formula:
IF(
  {manual discount},
  {manual discount},
  CEILING(
    IF(
      IS_BEFORE({Booking date lookup}, DATETIME_PARSE("2025-06-15")),
      {Minimum Final Total} * 0.025,
      {Minimum Final Total} * 0.035
    ),
    100
  )
)

fields.name: discount2
fields.description: Calculates a discount (2.5% or 4.5%) of Minimum Final Total, rounded up to the nearest $100.
fields.formula:
CEILING(
  IF(
    IS_BEFORE({Booking date lookup}, DATETIME_PARSE("2025-06-15")),
    {Minimum Final Total} * 0.015,
    {Minimum Final Total} * 0.025
  ),
  100
)

fields.name: discount3
fields.description: Calculates a conditional discount (1.5% or 3.5%) of Minimum Final Total, rounded up to the nearest $100.
fields.formula:
CEILING(
  IF(
    IS_BEFORE({Booking date lookup}, DATETIME_PARSE("2025-06-15")),
    {Minimum Final Total} * 0.005,
    {Minimum Final Total} * 0.015
  ),
  100
)

fields.name: Salutation
fields.description: Generates a salutation using titles and last names, capitalizing the first letter of each word.
fields.formula:
IF(
  AND(
    TRIM({Title}) = "",
    TRIM({Client_Secondary_Title}) = ""
  ),
  BLANK(),

  IF(
    AND(
      TRIM({Title}) != "",
      TRIM({Client_Last_Name}) != "",
      TRIM({Client_Secondary_Title}) != "",
      TRIM({Client_Secondary_Last_Name}) != ""
    ),

    IF(
      LOWER(TRIM({Client_Last_Name})) =
      LOWER(TRIM({Client_Secondary_Last_Name})),

      TRIM({Title}) &
      " and " &
      TRIM({Client_Secondary_Title}) &
      " " &
      TRIM({Client_Last_Name}),

      TRIM({Title}) &
      " " &
      TRIM({Client_Last_Name}) &
      " and " &
      TRIM({Client_Secondary_Title}) &
      " " &
      TRIM({Client_Secondary_Last_Name})
    ),

    IF(
      AND(
        TRIM({Title}) != "",
        TRIM({Client_Last_Name}) != ""
      ),

      TRIM({Title}) &
      " " &
      TRIM({Client_Last_Name}),

      IF(
        AND(
          TRIM({Client_Secondary_Title}) != "",
          TRIM({Client_Secondary_Last_Name}) != ""
        ),

        TRIM({Client_Secondary_Title}) &
        " " &
        TRIM({Client_Secondary_Last_Name}),

        BLANK()
      )
    )
  )
)

fields.description: NOT CURRENT: Assigns a commission rate (%) based on margin thresholds: 10% for margin ≥ 1.1, 5% for margin ≥ 0.75, 5% for margin between 0.25 and 0.75, otherwise 0%.
fields.formula:
IF(
  SEARCH("Eric Campbell", {REQUESTER} & ""),
  0.0375,
  IF(
    {Amount} < 0,
    0.05,
    IF(
      {Margin} >= 1.1,
      0.05,
      IF(
        {Margin} >= 0.75,
        0.05,
        IF(
          AND({Margin} > 0.25, {Margin} < 0.75),
          0.05,
          0
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
